# ctables/call

> Function call: the arguments are evaluated right to left, then passed.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/call.pkg) · translates [std/call](../std/call.md)

  Right to left is the order bintables pushes them in, so side effects in
  arguments happen in the same order with both backends.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when args empty`

```nasm
{callee.label}(0)
```

### `emit`

```nasm
({
{each args reverse}
W {it.L.v} =
{it}
;
{end}
{callee.label}(0
{each args}
, {it.L.v}
{end}
); })
```
